name: Souseiseki
source:
Artificial Spirit: Lempicka (レンピカ)

The fourth doll of the Rozen Maiden collection and [url=/c13632]Suiseiseki[/url]'s twin, Souseiseki possesses a sharpness in her speech that is similar to [url=/c13629]Shinku[/url]'s, attacks ruthlessly in combat, and does not tolerate sub-par actions. Her appearance is not only the most masculine of the dolls, but her speech is also noted to be of the masculine form, using the first person pronoun "boku" instead of gender neutral pronouns like "jibun" or "watashi." These all being stereotypical traits of a tomboy.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Rozen_Maiden_characters#Souseiseki]Wikipedia[/url].]
